title: GhoulCraft - RPG Survival
description: Survival server with Custom plugins to add Progression, Magic, Skills, Quests, Mob/Player Levelling
body:
# GhoulCraft

**Forge Your Path. Build Your Legacy.**

Welcome to a next-generation **RPG Survival** experience where progression, creativity, and immersive systems come together.

This isn’t just survival — it’s a world where **every action matters**.

Level up your skills, earn powerful rewards, and watch the world evolve around you.

---

## ⚔️ Server Style

A unique blend of:

- 🧭 **RPG Progression Survival**
- 💰 **Player-Driven Economy**
- 🌍 **Exploration & Adventure Focus**

Whether you’re a grinder, builder, or explorer, there’s always something meaningful to work toward.

---

## ✨ Features

### 📈 Skills

Progress through multiple skills just by playing:

- Mining
- Combat
- Farming
- Fishing
- And more

Includes:

- Real-time action bar progress
- Level-based progression
- Milestone unlocks
- Rewards for active gameplay

---

### 🏆 Milestones

Unlock powerful abilities as you level up:

- 🌲 **Tree Feller** — cut entire trees instantly
- 💎 **Double Drops & Rare Finds**
- 🌾 **Auto-Replant Farming**
- ⚔️ **Combat Bonuses**

Every skill has meaningful rewards, so no grind feels wasted.

---

### 🧙 Ranks

Choose your destiny and shape your playstyle:

- ⚔️ **Warrior**
- 🔨 **Artisan**
- 🏹 **Ranger**
- 📜 **Scholar**
- 🌍 **Nomad**

Each path gives unique bonuses and lets you progress your way.

---

### 💰 Economy

Earn rewards while you play:

- Mobs can drop coin bags
- Progression increases your earning potential
- Spend coins on shops, upgrades, and more

A rewarding economy built around active gameplay.

---

### 🌀 Prestige

Endgame progression that matters:

- Reset and grow stronger each time
- Gain Souls to protect your inventory on death
- Unlock long-term power boosts
- Keep chasing progression beyond max level

---

### 🌍 Exploration

The world evolves with you:

- Stronger mobs as you travel further
- Better rewards in dangerous areas
- Meaningful exploration
- Adventure beyond spawn

---

### 🛒 Shops

Trade freely with other players:

- Create your own shops
- Buy and sell items with ease
- Support a fully player-driven economy

---

### 🏡 Claims

Build with confidence:

- Claim land to protect your builds
- Keep your base safe
- Enjoy survival without griefing chaos

---

### 🛏️ QoL

Small things that make a big difference:

- Skip night with players
- Smooth teleportation
- Clean chat and UI systems
- A polished survival experience

---

## 🌟 Why Join?

- Rewarding progression
- Systems that respect your time
- A balance between grind and fun
- Constant goals to chase
- A server that feels alive

---

## 🚀 Join

Start as nothing.

**Become a legend.**
